Q6097.reason: Modern statutes in most states convert a fee tail into a fee simple absolute, so the cousin takes everything and the grantor keeps no reversion for the niece to receive.

Q5137.reason: Under the modern rule (FRE 703 and common practice), an expert may base an opinion on data reasonably relied on in the field, even if the x-rays are not in evidence.

Q5526.reason: Breaking into a hotel guest room (a dwelling) at night with intent to commit a crime inside fits burglary, while the other options lack a breaking, a dwelling, nighttime, or intent at entry.
